mock_help: Enable local mock mode. If disabled, the adapter runs in live mode.
mockScenario_help: Scenario used in mock mode to emulate different vehicle states.
clientId_help: OAuth client ID from your Ford developer app.
clientSecret_help: OAuth client secret from your Ford developer app.
mockDataPath_help: Path to local mock JSON file used when mock mode is enabled.
interval_help: Default is 5. In mock mode, lower intervals can be used for development.
